Title: Generally Available: Azure Firewall resource specific log tables get Azure Monitor Basic plan support

Body.Content:
All resource specific log tables for Azure Firewall now support the Basic log plan which can reduce your logging costs by 80%. However, Policy Analytics and Security Copilot integrations will not work with the Basic log plan.   

Learn more: 

  • About this new logging plan.   
  • About new querying experience.
